chapter: New York, Bostic and Dizzy Gillespie
title: How Dizzy Gillespie's band ended in Rome
summary: The band disbanded in Rome; the sextet played a few gigs but Gillespie was losing money.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: So you leave – what were the circumstances with leaving Dizzy’s band?
Okay. And then you went with the sextet too?

Yeah. We did just a couple of gigs with the sextet. Then that was it. Because I think he was losing money. He bought a bus that we would – a second-hand bus – we would travel in the bus. He was trying to make it work, but it was an uphill thing. The music was fantastic – nothing wrong with the music – but the surrounding circumstances weren’t always what they could have been, I think.
